'''Mosolium''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Mosolium was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. He was added to the [[Star Wars video games|game]] with the release of the [[2005]] expansion pack, [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']]. He was originally named Musolium, but the name was later changed to Mosolium for unknown reasons.
